messages.content: What is the vision of Trinidad Municipal College?

The vision of TMC is: A model institution with fully developed academic, technical-vocational education and skill of manpower with positive work attitudes anchored in the core values of leadership and professionalism essential in the creation of self-reliant citizens.
Can you tell me TMC's vision statement?

TMC's vision is to be a model institution with fully developed academic, technical-vocational education and skill of manpower with positive work attitudes anchored in the core values of leadership and professionalism essential in the creation of self-reliant citizens.
What does TMC envision for its students?

TMC envisions being a model institution with fully developed academic, technical-vocational education and skill of manpower with positive work attitudes anchored in the core values of leadership and professionalism essential in the creation of self-reliant citizens.
What is the mission of Trinidad Municipal College?
The mission of TMC is to build well-trained, competent and employable professionals, who will meet the demands of the local and international work places.
What is TMC's mission statement?
TMC's mission is to build well-trained, competent and employable professionals, who will meet the demands of the local and international work places.
What is the goal of TMC?

TMC aims at evolving a whole individual as a child of God and a member of a democratic society who is professionally competent that can provide leadership and advance knowledge, well-trained in a certain vocation not only to help himself but to help others, and practical yet responsible and obedient to the laws of God and to the laws of the government.
What is the philosophy of TMC?
TMC adheres to the philosophy that education is life and growth guided by faith in God and love of fellowmen in an environment of competitiveness, professionalism and excellence.
What is TMC's slogan?
TMC's slogan is: TMC is committed to public educational services second to none.
When was Trinidad Municipal College founded?
Trinidad Municipal College was founded in 1980 when Mr. Paciano Petarco initiated the plan for establishing a college institution in the Municipality of Trinidad, Bohol.
Who founded TMC?
Trinidad Municipal College was founded through the initiative of Mr. Paciano Petarco, who planned and sought support for establishing a college institution in Trinidad, Bohol in 1980.
When was Trinidad Junior College registered with the SEC?
Trinidad Junior College was registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) in 1985 with SEC No. 136393.
When was TMC turned over to the Local Government?
Trinidad Junior College was turned over to the Local Government of Trinidad on August 1, 2003, through a Deed of Sale under the leadership of then Municipal Mayor Engr. Filadelfo A. Garcia.
How many students does TMC have?
As of the 1st Semester of Academic Year 2022-2023, Trinidad Municipal College has a total enrolment of more than 7,000 students.
What is TMC's recognition status?

Trinidad Municipal College was recognized by the Commission on Higher Education (CHED) as a Higher Education Institution (HEI) pursuant to Commission en banc Resolution No. 564-2020 dated August 18, 2020.
What courses does TMC offer?

TMC offers the following CHED-authorized courses: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology (BSIT), Bachelor of Science in Office Administration (BSOA), Bachelor of Arts in Political Science, Bachelor of Arts in Communication, Bachelor of Secondary Education major in English, Bachelor of Elementary Education, and Bachelor of Science in Criminology. TESDA programs include Automotive Servicing NC-I, SMAW NC-I, and SMAW NC-II.
What are the academic programs at TMC?

TMC's academic programs are organized into colleges: College of Teacher Education (BEEd and BSEd), College of Arts and Sciences (BA Political Science and BA Communication), College of Computer Studies (BSIT), College of Criminal Justice Education (BSCrim), and College of Office Administration (BSOA).
Does TMC offer a BSIT program?

Yes, TMC offers a Bachelor of Science in Information Technology (BSIT) under the College of Computer Studies. It has a Certificate of Program Compliance (COPC) No. 0040 S. 2021, dated December 27, 2021.
Does TMC have a Criminology program?
Yes, TMC offers a Bachelor of Science in Criminology (BSCrim) under the College of Criminal Justice Education. It has a Certificate of Program Compliance (COPC) No. 057 S. 2022, dated May 10, 2022.
Does TMC offer teacher education?

Yes, TMC offers two teacher education programs: Bachelor of Elementary Education (BEEd) major in General Content and Bachelor of Secondary Education (BSEd) major in English, both under the College of Teacher Education.
What TESDA programs does TMC offer?
TMC offers three TESDA-recognized programs: Automotive Servicing NC-I, Shielded Metal Arc Welding (SMAW) NC-I, and Shielded Metal Arc Welding (SMAW) NC-II.
What are the admission requirements for new students at TMC?

New students at TMC need to submit: high school diploma or equivalent, Transcript of Records (Form 137), Certificate of Good Moral Character, Birth Certificate (PSA or NSO), 2x2 ID pictures (4 copies), Medical Certificate, Barangay Clearance, and Parent/Guardian consent form (for minors).
How do I enroll at TMC?

To enroll at TMC: Step 1 - Submit application and required documents to the Registrar's Office. Step 2 - Take the entrance examination if required. Step 3 - Interview with the Program Head. Step 4 - Evaluation of credentials. Step 5 - Acceptance notification. Step 6 - Enrollment and payment of fees.
What are the requirements for transferees at TMC?

Transferees at TMC need: Transfer Credential (Honorable Dismissal), Transcript of Records from previous school, Certificate of Good Moral Character, Birth Certificate (PSA or NSO), 2x2 ID pictures (4 copies), Medical Certificate, and course description from previous school for credit evaluation.
Is tuition free at TMC?

Yes, TMC is an LGU-managed institution that offers free tuition for all Filipino students enrolled in CHED-recognized programs under Republic Act 10931, the Universal Access to Quality Tertiary Education Act (UAQTEA). Miscellaneous fees may still apply.
What is the grading system at TMC?

TMC uses the following grading system: 1.00-1.25 (Excellent), 1.26-1.50 (Very Good), 1.51-1.75 (Good), 1.76-2.00 (Satisfactory), 2.01-2.25 (Fairly Satisfactory), 2.26-2.50 (Passing), 2.51-3.00 (Conditional), 5.00 (Failed), INC (Incomplete), DRP (Dropped).
What grades do I need to graduate with honors at TMC?

TMC recognizes the following academic honors: Summa Cum Laude (GWA 1.00-1.25), Magna Cum Laude (GWA 1.26-1.50), Cum Laude (GWA 1.51-1.75), and With Honors (GWA 1.76-2.00). Students must have no grade lower than 2.00 in any course and complete the program within the prescribed period.
What are the requirements to graduate from TMC?

To graduate from TMC, students must: complete all required courses in the curriculum, meet the minimum GWA, have no outstanding financial obligations, obtain clearance from all offices, submit all required documents, and pay graduation fees.
What are the miscellaneous fees at TMC?

TMC miscellaneous fees include: Registration (PHP 200), Library (PHP 150), Laboratory (PHP 300), Student Activities (PHP 200), Development (PHP 500), Medical/Dental (PHP 100), Athletics (PHP 100), Cultural (PHP 100), School ID (PHP 100 one-time), and Insurance (PHP 100 per semester).
What is the academic calendar of TMC?
TMC follows the semester system: First Semester (June to October), Second Semester (November to March), and Summer (April to May).
How many units can a full-time faculty teach at TMC?
Full-time faculty at TMC have a minimum of 15 units and maximum of 24 units per semester. Overload teaching requires approval from the Department Head and Academic Affairs.
What are the qualifications for faculty at TMC?

Faculty at TMC must have: Bachelor's degree for instructor positions, Master's degree for senior instructor positions, Doctoral degree for professorial positions, Filipino citizenship or proper work authorization, good moral character, and must pass the TMC faculty selection process.
What is the faculty evaluation system at TMC?

Faculty at TMC are evaluated through: Student Evaluation of Faculty (end of each semester), Peer Evaluation (at least once per academic year), and Administrative Evaluation (at least once per semester). Ratings include Outstanding, Very Satisfactory, Satisfactory, Needs Improvement, and Unsatisfactory.
Does TMC support faculty research?

Yes, TMC encourages faculty research. Full-time faculty must participate in at least one research project per academic year and present findings at least once per academic year. TMC provides research grants, supports publication fees, and holds an annual Research Colloquium.
How do I request my Transcript of Records at TMC?

To request a Transcript of Records at TMC: Step 1 - Fill out the Document Request Form. Step 2 - Submit to the Document Processing Section. Step 3 - Pay PHP 50.00 at the Accounting Office. Step 4 - Present the official receipt. Step 5 - Claim the document within five (5) working days for regular processing, or one (1) to two (2) working days for rush processing (with additional fee).
What is the Registrar's Office at TMC responsible for?

The Registrar's Office at TMC is responsible for: student enrollment and registration, academic records management, issuance of official academic documents, graduation and credentialing, CHED compliance and reporting, scholarship coordination, and student information system management.
What does the Accounting Office at TMC do?

The Accounting Office at TMC is responsible for: tuition and fee collection, financial record keeping and accounting, budget preparation and monitoring, financial reporting and auditing, disbursement of funds, payroll processing, and procurement support.
What is the HR office at TMC responsible for?

The Human Resource Management Office (HRMO) at TMC is responsible for: recruitment and selection of personnel, onboarding and orientation, performance management, employee relations and welfare, compensation and benefits administration, training and development, and records management.
What is the Student Affairs Office at TMC?

The Student Affairs Office at TMC manages: student organizations and activities, student discipline and welfare, guidance and counseling services, scholarship programs, and student development programs.
What was TMC originally called?

TMC was originally named Trinidad Junior College when it was registered with the SEC in 1985. It was renamed Trinidad Municipal College on August 1, 2003, when ownership was turned over to the Local Government of Trinidad.
Who was the mayor when TMC was turned over to the LGU?

Trinidad Junior College was turned over to the Local Government of Trinidad on August 1, 2003, under the leadership of then Municipal Mayor Engr. Filadelfo A. Garcia, Vice Mayor Francisco U. Gonzales, and the Sangguniang Bayan Members.
What was the first college course offered at TMC?

The first courses offered at Trinidad Junior College included: 2-year Diploma in Applied Technology major in Electricity and Construction, 2-year Associate in Secretarial Administration, 2-year Automotive Mechanic Course, and 1-year General Clerical Course.
When was the Bachelor of Arts degree approved at TMC?
The Bachelor of Arts degree was approved by the Department of Education, Culture and Sports (DECS) in 1993 at Trinidad Junior College.
What is RA 10931 and how does it affect TMC students?

RA 10931, also known as the Universal Access to Quality Tertiary Education Act (UAQTEA), provides free tuition for all Filipino students enrolled in CHED-recognized programs. TMC became a recipient of this benefit in the 2nd semester of academic year 2018-2019.
Does TMC have a library?

Yes, TMC has a library that provides access to print and digital resources, supports research and learning, manages library operations and services, coordinates information literacy programs, and maintains the library collection.
Does TMC have computer laboratories?
Yes, TMC has computer laboratories that provide computer and internet access for academic purposes. The College of Computer Studies uses these facilities for BSIT program courses.
What are the office hours at TMC?
TMC's regular office hours are: Monday to Friday, 7:30 AM to 5:00 PM; Saturday, 7:30 AM to 12:00 PM for selected services; Sunday and Holidays, Closed.
Where is TMC located?
Trinidad Municipal College is located in the Municipality of Trinidad, Province of Bohol, Philippines.
Who is the current mayor of Trinidad?
The current mayor of Trinidad is Atty. Roberto C. Cajes, Ph.D., who succeeded his wife, former Mayor Judith Del Rosario-Cajes.
How many students were enrolled when Mayor Cajes first took office?

Before Mayor Judith Del Rosario-Cajes assumed office on June 30, 2007, Trinidad Municipal College had a total enrolment of only 510 students. Under her leadership and continuing under Mayor Atty. Roberto C. Cajes, enrollment grew to over 7,000 students.
Does TMC offer scholarships?

Yes, TMC offers various scholarship programs including: CHED UniFAST scholarships, TMC Academic Scholarship, TMC Athletic Scholarship, TMC Cultural Scholarship, LGU Scholarship for Trinidad residents, and Private Scholarships from external organizations.
What are the requirements for a TMC scholarship?

Scholarship requirements at TMC include: Filipino citizenship, enrollment or planned enrollment at TMC, meeting the specific requirements of the chosen scholarship, and not receiving another scholarship covering the same expenses. Academic scholars must maintain a GWA of at least 85% with no grade lower than 80%.
Does TMC have a research ethics committee?

Yes, TMC has a Research Ethics Committee (REC) composed of five members that reviews and approves all research involving human participants. The REC meets at least once a month and provides ethics clearance certificates for approved research proposals.
Does TMC have student organizations?

Yes, TMC recognizes student organizations including the Supreme Student Council (SSC), college-level student councils, departmental organizations, special interest organizations, and fraternities and sororities subject to TMC guidelines.
How do I file a complaint at TMC?

To file a complaint or grievance at TMC: Step 1 - Submit a written complaint to the Department Head. Step 2 - If unresolved, elevate to the Academic Affairs Office or HRMO. Step 3 - The Grievance Committee investigates and renders a decision. Step 4 - Appeal may be made to the College President within fifteen (15) working days. Grievances must be filed within thirty (30) working days from the date of the incident.
Does TMC have an anti-harassment policy?

Yes, TMC has a strict anti-harassment policy. Faculty and staff are prohibited from engaging in any form of sexual harassment or discrimination. Violations may result in disciplinary actions including verbal warning, written warning, suspension, demotion, or dismissal.
What are the steps for graduation at TMC?

Steps for graduation at TMC: Step 1 - File application for graduation at the Registrar's Office. Step 2 - Complete all academic requirements. Step 3 - Obtain clearance from all offices. Step 4 - Pay graduation fees (PHP 800). Step 5 - Attend the commencement exercises. Step 6 - Claim diploma within thirty (30) working days after graduation.
What is the late enrollment fee at TMC?
The late enrollment fee at TMC is PHP 200.00, charged to students who enroll after the official enrollment period but within the first week of classes.
What is the drop/add period at TMC?
The drop/add period at TMC is within the first two (2) weeks of classes. Students may add or drop subjects during this period with proper processing at the Registrar's Office.
What happens if I exceed the allowed absences at TMC?
At TMC, students exceeding 20% absences in a course must be reported to the Academic Affairs Office. Faculty must also submit a mid-term grade for students at risk of failing.
Can I cross-enroll at TMC?
Yes, students from other institutions may cross-enroll at TMC for a maximum of nine (9) units. A permit to cross-enroll must be obtained from both the home institution and TMC.
Does TMC offer evening classes?
Yes, TMC offers evening classes from 5:30 PM to 9:00 PM for working students, as well as morning classes (7:00 AM to 12:00 PM) and afternoon classes (1:00 PM to 5:00 PM).
How can I contact TMC?

You can contact TMC through: Telephone at (038) XXX-XXXX, Email at the appropriate office address (registrar@tmc.edu.ph, accounting@tmc.edu.ph, hrmo@tmc.edu.ph, research@tmc.edu.ph), or visit the campus in Trinidad, Bohol, Philippines.
What is the refund policy at TMC?

For non-UNIFAST scholars: Full refund within the first week, 80% refund in the second week, 50% refund in the third week, and no refund after the third week for tuition. For miscellaneous fees: Full refund in the first week, 50% refund in the second week, and no refund after the second week.
Does TMC have a canteen?
Yes, TMC has a canteen and cafeteria on campus that provides food and refreshments for students and employees.
Is there parking at TMC?
Yes, TMC has a parking area on campus for students, employees, and visitors.
Does TMC have a gymnasium?
Yes, TMC has an auditorium and gymnasium used for events, assemblies, and sports activities.
Does TMC have sports programs?
Yes, TMC has sports programs including intramural sports and varsity teams. TMC offers athletic scholarships for student athletes who excel in their respective sports.
What are the TMC core values?

TMC is anchored on the core values of leadership and professionalism, as stated in its vision. The institution also values competitiveness, excellence, faith in God, and love of fellowmen as reflected in its philosophy.
Is TMC a private or public institution?

TMC is an LGU-managed (Local Government Unit) public institution. It was turned over to the Local Government of Trinidad, Bohol on August 1, 2003, and is recognized by CHED as a Higher Education Institution.
What is the student-to-faculty ratio at TMC?
The specific student-to-faculty ratio at TMC is not available in the current source documents. However, TMC maintains quality instruction with qualified faculty across all its colleges.
Does TMC have a guidance counselor?
Yes, TMC provides guidance and counseling services through the Student Affairs Office. These services are available to all students for academic, personal, and career concerns.
Does TMC offer OJT or internship?
Yes, several TMC programs require On-the-Job Training (OJT) or internship as part of the curriculum, including BSIT, BSOA, BA Political Science, and BSCrim programs.
What is the TMC capstone project requirement?

TMC requires a capstone project or thesis for all undergraduate programs. The specific requirements vary by program: BEEd/BSEd require a teaching portfolio, BSIT requires a capstone project, BA PolSci and BSCrim require a research paper, and BA Comm requires a portfolio.
Can TMC students use the library for research?
Yes, the TMC Library provides access to print and digital resources for research and learning. The library also maintains the TMC Research Repository where completed research papers are archived.
Does TMC have Wi-Fi?
Yes, TMC provides internet and Wi-Fi access for students and employees as part of its student welfare services.
Does TMC have a medical clinic?
Yes, TMC provides medical and dental services as part of its student welfare services. A medical certificate from a licensed physician is also required for enrollment.
What is the Intramural program at TMC?
TMC organizes intramural sports as part of its student development programs. These are inter-college athletic competitions held within the institution to promote sportsmanship and physical fitness.
Does TMC have a Supreme Student Council?
Yes, TMC has a Supreme Student Council (SSC) as the highest student governing body. The SSC is one of the recognized student organizations at the institution.
How do I apply for a TMC scholarship?

To apply for a TMC scholarship: Step 1 - Secure a scholarship application form from the Registrar's Office. Step 2 - Complete the form and attach required documents. Step 3 - Submit the application to the Scholarship Committee. Step 4 - Undergo evaluation and interview. Step 5 - Receive notification of approval or denial.
What is the TMC academic probation policy?

Students at TMC are placed on academic probation if their General Weighted Average (GWA) falls below 2.00. Probationary students must improve their GWA within two semesters. Failure to improve results in academic dismissal.
What is the policy on academic dishonesty at TMC?

Academic dishonesty, including plagiarism and cheating, is strictly prohibited at TMC. Research papers are checked using plagiarism detection software. Violations may result in automatic failure of the course, disciplinary action, or revocation of degree if discovered after graduation.
Can TMC students transfer to other schools?

Yes, TMC students may transfer to other schools by requesting an Honorable Dismissal (Transfer Credential) from the Registrar's Office. The student must have no outstanding financial obligations and must complete the clearance process.
What is the process for getting an honorable dismissal from TMC?

To get an Honorable Dismissal from TMC: Step 1 - Submit a request to the Registrar's Office. Step 2 - Complete the clearance process from all offices. Step 3 - Settle any outstanding financial obligations. Step 4 - The Registrar processes the Transfer Credential. Step 5 - Claim the Honorable Dismissal from the Registrar's Office.
What are the office hours for the Accounting Office at TMC?
The Accounting Office at TMC is open Monday to Friday from 7:30 AM to 5:00 PM, and Saturday from 7:30 AM to 12:00 PM. Cashier operations are from 7:30 AM to 4:00 PM.
Does TMC accept cashless payments?
Yes, TMC accepts cashless payments through GCash and PayMaya for selected fees, as well as bank deposits for large amounts and online payment through the TMC payment portal.
What is the 13th month pay at TMC?
The 13th month pay at TMC is equivalent to one-twelfth (1/12) of the total basic salary earned during the calendar year. It is released in December of each year as mandated by law.
What are the leave benefits for TMC employees?

TMC employees are entitled to: Vacation leave (15 working days/year), Sick leave (15 working days/year), Maternity leave (105 days under RA 11210), Paternity leave (7 days under RA 8187), Solo parent leave (60 days under RA 8972), and Special leave for women (60 days under RA 9710).
What is the retirement age at TMC?

Regular retirement at TMC is at age 60, with compulsory retirement at age 65. Early retirement is available as provided by law and TMC policies. Retirement benefits include retirement pay, pro-rated 13th month pay, and cash equivalent of unused leave credits.
Does TMC have an extension and community relations program?

Yes, TMC has an Extension and Community Relations Office that coordinates community extension programs, manages partnerships with external organizations, and implements outreach and social responsibility programs.
What research funding is available at TMC?

TMC provides internal research grants for approved proposals. Faculty and students may also seek external funding from CHED, DOST, other government agencies, and private organizations. Research fees may be subsidized by TMC subject to budget availability.
Does TMC have a plagiarism policy?

Yes, TMC has a strict plagiarism policy. All research papers are checked for plagiarism using Turnitin or similar software. Plagiarism may result in automatic failure, disciplinary action, or revocation of degree if discovered after graduation.
What is the TMC data privacy policy?

TMC complies with the Data Privacy Act (RA 10173). Student and employee records are confidential. Only authorized personnel may access records. Data breaches must be reported immediately to the Data Protection Officer. Personal information is not released to third parties without consent.
Does TMC have fire safety protocols?

Yes, TMC has fire safety protocols including clearly marked fire exits, fire extinguishers in designated areas, fire drills conducted at least twice a year, and a prohibition on open flames and smoking inside buildings.
What is the TMC property disposal policy?
TMC property disposal follows government property disposal rules under RA 9184. All property is inventoried and tagged, and annual physical inventory is conducted by the Supply and Property Office.
Can TMC faculty pursue graduate studies?

Yes, TMC supports faculty in pursuing graduate studies through study leave and tuition subsidy. Faculty with at least five years of service may apply for study leave for up to one academic year and must return to TMC for at least two years after.
What is the TMC salary standardization?

TMC follows the Salary Standardization Table (SST) for LGU employees. Salary grades are determined by position and qualifications. Annual salary increases are provided through the Salary Standardization and Enhancement Fund (SSEF).
What is the TMC procurement process?

TMC procurement follows: Step 1 - Requisition submitted by requesting office. Step 2 - Budget availability verified. Step 3 - Procurement processed by Supply and Property Office. Step 4 - Bidding or negotiation conducted. Step 5 - Award made to winning bidder. Step 6 - Delivery and inspection. Step 7 - Payment processed. Procurement methods include small value procurement (below PHP 50,000) and competitive bidding (PHP 50,000 and above).
Does TMC participate in the AACUP accreditation?

Yes, TMC pursues program accreditation with the Association of Accrediting Agencies of the Philippines (AACUP). Accreditation levels include Level I, Level II, and Level III, and is voluntary but encouraged for quality improvement.
What is the TMC Internal Quality Assurance System?

TMC implements an Internal Quality Assurance System (IQAS) that includes regular program review and curriculum evaluation, faculty development and training, student feedback and satisfaction surveys, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Does TMC have a social media policy?

Yes, TMC has a social media policy. Official TMC social media accounts are managed by the designated office. Employees must not post confidential information on social media. Social media must not be used for personal political advocacy. Violations may result in disciplinary action.
What emergency numbers should I know at TMC?
Emergency contact numbers at TMC: Campus Security at (038) XXX-XXXX, Local Police at (038) XXX-XXXX, Fire Department at (038) XXX-XXXX, and Hospital at (038) XXX-XXXX.
What is the TMC visitor policy?

TMC visitors must: register at the security desk, be accompanied by a TMC employee or student, leave the campus before 5:00 PM unless attending an official event, and coordinate group visits with the Administration Office.
Does TMC offer summer classes?

Yes, TMC offers summer classes from April to May as part of its semester system. Summer classes are typically used for acceleration, removal of incomplete grades, or taking subjects ahead of the regular semesters.
What is the salary grade of a faculty member at TMC?

Faculty salary grades at TMC depend on academic rank and qualifications, following the Salary Standardization Table for LGU employees. Specific salary amounts are determined by the approved SST and may vary based on step level within each salary grade.
What is the TMC policy on outside employment for faculty?

Faculty at TMC must not engage in outside employment without proper authorization. Outside employment that conflicts with teaching duties or TMC's interests is prohibited. Faculty must disclose any outside employment to the HRMO.
Does TMC have a records retention policy?

Yes, TMC has a records retention policy: Administrative records (7 years), Financial records (7 years), Academic records (permanent), Legal records (as required by law), and Transitory records (3 years).
Does TMC conduct fire drills?
Yes, TMC conducts fire drills at least twice a year as part of its fire safety protocols. All employees and students are required to participate in the drills.
What is the TMC policy on gift-giving to faculty?
TMC's Code of Conduct prohibits faculty from accepting gifts or favors that may influence academic decisions. This is to maintain academic integrity and prevent conflicts of interest.
Does TMC have an annual research colloquium?

Yes, TMC holds an annual Research Colloquium where all completed research must be presented. Best research awards are given to outstanding researchers. The colloquium promotes research culture and networking among faculty and students.
How many colleges does TMC have?
TMC has five colleges: College of Teacher Education, College of Arts and Sciences, College of Computer Studies, College of Criminal Justice Education, and College of Office Administration.
What is the BSIT program at TMC about?

The Bachelor of Science in Information Technology (BSIT) at TMC is under the College of Computer Studies. It covers programming, networking, database management, and web development. It has COPC No. 0040 S. 2021 and prepares students for careers in IT, software development, and systems administration.
What is the BSOA program at TMC about?

The Bachelor of Science in Office Administration (BSOA) at TMC is under the College of Office Administration. It covers office management, business communication, records management, and entrepreneurship. It has COPC No. 026 S. 2022 and prepares students for careers in office administration, business, and management.
What is the BEEd program at TMC about?

The Bachelor of Elementary Education (BEEd) major in General Content at TMC is under the College of Teacher Education. It is a four-year program that prepares students for the Licensure Examination for Teachers (LET). It has COPC No. 062 S. 2022.
What is the BSEd program at TMC about?

The Bachelor of Secondary Education (BSEd) major in English at TMC is under the College of Teacher Education. It is a four-year program that prepares students for the Licensure Examination for Teachers (LET). It has COPC No. 061 S. 2022.
What is the BA Political Science program at TMC?

The Bachelor of Arts in Political Science at TMC is under the College of Arts and Sciences. It covers political theory, public administration, international relations, and Philippine government. It has COPC No. 052 S. 2022 and prepares students for careers in government, law, and public service.
What is the BA Communication program at TMC?

The Bachelor of Arts in Communication at TMC is under the College of Arts and Sciences. It covers journalism, broadcasting, public relations, and media studies. It has COPC No. 074 S. 2022 and prepares students for careers in media, communications, and public relations.
What is the BSCrim program at TMC about?

The Bachelor of Science in Criminology (BSCrim) at TMC is under the College of Criminal Justice Education. It covers criminal law, criminology, forensic science, and law enforcement. It has COPC No. 057 S. 2022 and prepares students for careers in law enforcement and criminal justice.
Does TMC have a motorcycle or vehicle parking policy?
TMC has a parking area on campus for students, employees, and visitors. Specific parking policies and fees may be implemented by the Administration Office.
Does TMC allow bringing pets on campus?
TMC campus rules and regulations prohibit bringing pets inside campus buildings. Service animals may be allowed with proper coordination with the Administration Office.
What is the dress code at TMC?

TMC requires students to dress appropriately on campus. Specifically, slippers, tank tops, and revealing clothing are not allowed inside classrooms. Students must wear proper identification at all times.
Does TMC have a student handbook?

Yes, TMC has a Student Manual (Revised November 18, 2022) that contains the institution's policies, procedures, and guidelines for students. It covers enrollment, academic policies, student welfare, and campus regulations.
What does the Director of Student Affairs do at TMC?

The Director of Student Affairs at TMC manages student organizations and activities, coordinates student discipline and welfare, provides guidance and counseling services, manages scholarship programs, and oversees student development programs.
What is the tuition fee for the BSIT program at TMC?
The available TMC source does not contain this information. Please contact the Registrar's Office or Accounting Office for the latest fee schedule.
What is the enrollment deadline for the upcoming semester?
The available TMC source does not contain this information. Please check the TMC website or contact the Registrar's Office for the current enrollment schedule.
Who is the current college president of TMC?
The available TMC source does not contain this information. Please contact the Office of the College President for the name of the current president.
What is the exact salary of a TMC faculty member?
The available TMC source does not contain this information. TMC follows the Salary Standardization Table for LGU employees. Please contact the HRMO for specific salary grades.
When is the next school holiday at TMC?
The available TMC source does not contain this information. Please refer to the official academic calendar or the Department of Education national holiday schedule.
What is the address of the TMC President's office?
The available TMC source does not contain this information. Please contact the Administration Office for office location and contact details.
Does TMC offer master's degree programs?
The available TMC source does not contain this information. Please contact the Registrar's Office to confirm which programs are currently offered.
What is the grading curve used in TMC examinations?
The available TMC source does not contain this information. Please contact the Academic Affairs Office for specifics on grading standards.
How many books are in the TMC library?
The available TMC source does not contain this information. Please contact the Library Office for the current inventory.
Is there a bus route that stops directly in front of the TMC campus?
The available TMC source does not contain this information. Please contact the Administration Office or the local transport office for directions.
